newsitem.title: JAPAN: All months of Tokyo corn futures end lower.
newsitem.headline: All months of Tokyo corn futures end lower.

text.p: All months of Tokyo corn futures closed lower on Tuesday, as Chicago corn market price falls overnight triggered active selling from local investors, traders said.
The limit-less spot January ended down 530 yen at 15,350. Others were 70 to 210 yen lower, with benchmark November 1997 down 150 yen at 13,650. Daily volume was 52,557 lots.

Individual investors, discouraged by the price drops of the CBOT corn market overnight, started selling from the opening, traders said. "Some powerful investors liquidated their long positions in late afternoon," a brokerage trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.66-1/4 per bushel at 0845 GMT, against $2.66-3/4 at Monday's close.
The spot January contract of CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.84-1/2 per bushel at 0845 GMT, against $6.88-3/4 at Monday's close.
